mago_exception: MAGO_broad.csv gives angular frequency; divide x by 2*pi and y by sqrt(2*pi), matching the authors loader.
ligo_note: Use the simplified O4a curve to avoid duplicate frequencies in the detailed digitisation. The association with HorLigoO4as follows its filename; exact numerical reproduction is not asserted.
rate_note: dyr_fPBH=* tables have distances in kpc; multiply by 1000 for pc, matching the notebook.
interpolation: Linear in log(f), log(ASD) or log(chirp mass), log(distance). Return NaN outside native bounds; no extrapolation.

photon_regeneration.units: The second column is noise-equivalent strain ASD [Hz^-1/2]. Square after interpolation to obtain PSD [Hz^-1].
photon_regeneration.interpretation: ALPS II, JURA and IAXO are projected GW sensitivities; OSQAR II and CAST are reference sensitivities from existing photon-conversion instruments. Native receiver bands and incidence assumptions apply.
photon_regeneration.reach_caveat: These are photon-counting instruments. Signal photon counts, backgrounds, exposure and directional acceptance are required for reach calculations; a noise-equivalent PSD alone does not justify using a linear matched-filter reach formula.
photon_regeneration.horizons: No binary horizon tables supplied. The original ten-curve shark-fin plot is retained.
photon_regeneration.resonant_alps_ii: Not included: ALPSIIRes.txt is a single-frequency benchmark, whereas the added ALPSII.txt is the broadband curve.

analytic_display_note: The combined plot preserves the previous analytic MWB/LIGO-HF display range, capped at max(1e9 Hz, highest native frequency in the original ten-curve shark-fin catalogue), currently 9.67084860994832e10 Hz. This is a display cap, not a physical validity claim; no optical/X-ray extrapolation is drawn.

response_models.definition: Amplitude envelope e-folding time; not a minimum source lifetime. Propagation windows are separate.
response_models.coverage: All fourteen default plotted detector configurations.
response_models.hypotheses: The user authorised hypothetical receiver models on 2026-11-16. Missing broadband/readout dynamics use an editable first-order 1 MHz baseband envelope pole. LIGO HF uses an explicitly assumed representative comb-tooth power FWHM of 1 kHz.
response_models.source_status: Published component parameters, nominal/geometry benchmarks, and hypothetical parameters are distinguished per component. These are not full calibrated detector transfer functions.
response_models.reach: The one-second placeholder rejection was removed. Monochromatic steady-state reach is retained as an approximation, with duration/assumption warnings and optional strict response checks; no universal ring-up multiplier is applied to an input-referred PSD.
